status: Proposed collection profiles; working-group and Gen3 deployment review required

profiles.name: human_clinical
profiles.scope: Human diagnosis, treatment and follow-up with optional product-to-administration traceability.
profiles.requirements: Keep existing MIDRC case and typed imaging parents; prescriptions and dispensing identify the same case and cycle; units identify their batch and expiry.
profiles.not_required: No preclinical or digital-twin record is mandatory for a clinical patient.

profiles.name: radiopharmacy
profiles.scope: Manufacturing, package specifications, material lots, preparation, unit inventory and timed QC.
profiles.requirements: Use nonpatient radiopharmaceutical_test subjects; retain method, units, result status, specification and reference times. Authorized batch disposition is separate.
profiles.not_required: No fabricated patient is created for batch QC; passing a test is not an automated release decision.

profiles.name: reference_research
profiles.scope: Published, preclinical, in-vitro and cohort evidence.
profiles.requirements: Identify setting, species/population, statistic, method, matrix/anatomy, time and source. Separate one result per quantity.
profiles.not_required: No automatic transfer of a cohort result to an individual human record.

profiles.name: digital_twin_research
profiles.scope: Versioned model specifications, runs, parameters and predictions.
profiles.requirements: Identify exact model release, input provenance, information cutoff, parameter units and scenario. Predictions remain separate from measured dose/outcomes.
profiles.not_required: No model execution, readiness score, clinical decision policy or safety approval is supplied.

unit_policy: Numeric results carry units. Fractions use 1, percentages use %, mass and molar activity use distinct denominator units. Other units require reviewed conversion; missing values are not zeros.
legacy_policy: Read legacy product-like radiopharmaceutical records and ambiguous batch activity fields unchanged. Curate an explicit agent/product split and timed QC result before using the new normalized profile; never infer a molar/mass denominator.
